primary_task: Run a read-only documentation drift audit of a repository in the working directory, comparing README/docs/env/CLI claims against the code, and report findings with P0-P3 severities and path:line evidence.

requirements.name: read/search files (read, grep, glob)
requirements.evidence: Search README files, docs folders, API docs, OpenAPI/Swagger specs, changelogs, setup guides ...
requirements.basis: read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)

requirements.name: git
requirements.evidence: 1. Establish source of truth. - Check `git status --short`.
requirements.basis: run shell commands on Linux x86_64: ... build, test, run CLIs and scripts, git, gh

requirements.name: python (scripts/docs_drift.py)
requirements.evidence: Run the bundled `scripts/docs_drift.py` first when it is available. ... Use `python` if `python3` is not on PATH.
requirements.basis: run shell commands on Linux x86_64: ... build, test, run CLIs and scripts (python3 is standard software on Linux; also installable: "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu ...)")

requirements.name: external/web docs
requirements.evidence: If web docs, private docs, rendered docs, or external API docs are unavailable, continue with local source inspection and state the limitation.
requirements.basis: fetch a web page or unauthenticated API by URL; hosts outside the egress allow-list are refused (depends on which docs host)

notes: Core work is local reading, grep and git; the bundled script is conditional ('when it is available'). External docs are optional and the document says to continue without them. Docs build/link checks are 'when available' and dependency installs are explicitly discouraged. No reading makes it blocked.
